sloka: अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरस्सरम् ।सहपुत्रं वधिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि ।। ५.५९.९ ।।।।
transliteration: ahaṁ tu rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe sasainyaṁ sapurassaram ।sahaputraṁ vadhiṣyāmi sahodarayutaṁ yudhi ।। 5.59.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "I can also kill all the army, his followers, sons and brothers of Ravana in war.
